name: The Last Refuge (Fallen Empires prototype)
license: GPL-3.0 (the game's own license; see LICENSE.txt)
description: Sail to an island of Sarpadian refugees, win five communities' pledges and challenge the Ebon Crown.
learning_note: A game-design and learning demo: original fiction, not official Magic canon and not new official content. It shows every part of the plugin format in one finished, playable island, for plugin authors to read, play and take apart.
